primary_endpoint: mean daily net log bankroll growth
cluster: UTC day across all cities; sensitivity to 7-day weather-system blocks
multiple_testing: Holm correction over all registered candidates; nested selection within development only
promotion_requires: positive Holm-adjusted lower confidence bound for net daily log growth in final holdout and forward shadow separately
positive realistic and pessimistic net P&L after contemporaneous fees and depth/latency/slippage
available-time and revision audits on all trade features
no final holdout reuse; any change requires new unobserved forward data
parameter perturbations keep net log growth positive in >=80% of preregistered local variants
delay and shifted-signal placebo comparisons with mechanism-consistent results
risk estimates include serial/cross-city dependence, costs, capital lockup, and parameter uncertainty

execution_sensitivity.maker: zero fills without queue/trade-through evidence; touching is not a fill

notes: Minimum sample sizes are necessary, not sufficient. No growth or target-hit probability estimate until independent edge evidence exists. Protocol amendments are append-only with date and rationale.
